scope: First frozen-code DocWeave extraction on this issuer's original full seven-page financial tables PDF. All ten native and two source-tagged profiles run uniformly, no models or OCR. Complete first three core statements selected from independent Poppler text/renders before extraction. Every original reference row retained; exact ordinal comparison and geometry-only IoU>=.5 association. This is frozen-code transfer/development evidence, not independently human-reviewed held-out acceptance or PDF cell/span labels. Follow-up frozen configuration experiment adds both explicit PAINTED_MODES source-table profiles uniformly on the complete original source, after source ownership diagnostics. Existing12profiles and all120reference rows unchanged. No glyph/source/reference repair or new production filtering. Previously observed development source, not new held-out evidence. Separate candidate appends explicit logical-cell text envelope profile. Source-owned cells keep existing logical topology; unrelated glyphs in gaps remain ordinary. Any unknown glyph center within a real cell text envelope still rejects the whole table. All prior14profiles and120rows/profile retained, no source/reference repair, visibility filtering, model or OCR. Previously observed development source.
source_note: Original publisher-served tagged Acrobat Distiller 25 PDF, Letter612x792 rotation0. HTML tables8/9/10 exclude external issuer/title/unit labels. Source PDF text inventory includes Quarter Group not visible in the page1 render; no repair or hidden-text filtering introduced. PDF visible date/year lines differ from HTML cell presentation; reference scoring remains unchanged. Browser-reencoded-plus CDN link returned403; exact raw publisher HTML href downloaded successfully before any extraction. Separate calendar fetch had DNS failure and was unnecessary once original press-release links were available.

protocol.extraction: Complete original PDF per mode, native defaults plus cell geometry. No reference/page/ROI inputs to extraction; source-dependent failures retain both cases in denominator.
protocol.references: Issuer-authored SEC HTML tables by fixed document-order index. Direct tr rows for that table, direct td/th wholeText joined by ASCII space. Map NBSP to display space, collapse ASCII whitespace only, trim only those spaces, drop wholly blank rows. Preserve punctuation/case/numeric formatting and all other Unicode. SHA256 of newline-joined normalized nonblank rows without trailing newline.
protocol.selection: Fixed source pages and displayed ROIs from PDF page rendering before DocWeave extraction. Max parent IoU >=0.5, stable first-index tie; never text-based association.
protocol.comparison: Exact nonblank row text at original nonblank row index. Do not shift rows, join fragments, fuzzy match, fix parentheses/currency/numbers or use content to choose a table. Keep missing/extra rows separate.
protocol.limits: HTML presentational cells/spans are NOT labels for PDF physical topology. No physical-span accuracy, cell-box accuracy or semantic-merge claim.
